title: D&D 2024 fungible physical item quantity

count.description: The number of indistinguishable physical items represented by this entity. Zero is never stored.

stackKey.description: An immutable mechanic-derived compatibility key. In Slice 4 it exactly equals the item-instance definitionId; callers do not choose it.

$comment: Governed by procedure.mechanic.dnd2024.item-quantity. A future feature that makes a physical property fungibility-relevant must revise the derived stack-key contract before it permits merging those items.
